implementation.checkpoint_policy: No upstream assay checkpoint is admitted. Train one model inside each outer donor, genomic, cell-state, and seed partition and hash every HDF5 artifact.

inference_contract.donor_context: none; predictions are cell-state and sequence specific but not donor conditioned
inference_contract.reverse_complement: average forward and reverse-complement predictions after restoring profile orientation
inference_contract.variant_primary_score: ALT_minus_REF log_total_count averaged across orientations and five fixed seeds
inference_contract.variant_to_gene_limit: BPNet predicts sequence-driven accessibility profiles and counts, not enhancer-gene links or signed expression effects. Any link/direction composite is a distinct frozen model.

input_contract.canonical_sequence: GRCh38.p14 one-hot ACGT sequence with coordinate and REF-allele validation
input_contract.control_policy: No control or bias bigWig is supplied; this keeps BPNet a from-scratch sequence-only architecture control distinct from bias-factorized ChromBPNet.
input_contract.peak_and_profile_policy: Use the same training-fold-only donor-state pseudobulk insertion profiles, peaks, matched nonpeaks, reference, held genomic blocks, and row identifiers as ChromBPNet.
input_contract.training_augmentation: 128-bp maximum jitter and reverse-complement augmentation, frozen before execution
input_contract.warning: The CLI training default input length is 3,088 bp while the model default is 2,114 bp. The benchmark explicitly fixes 2,114 bp and rejects an implicit CLI default.

source_evidence: The pinned repository commit and PyPI 2.0.0 metadata were queried on 2026-08-22. Source code was inspected without installing the package, running TensorFlow, or downloading a checkpoint.
